answer: Stake-proportional reward shares. For agents analyzing pigment samples, garden conditions, or raven calls, distribute a fixed reward pool linearly by escrowed stake, with no per-account bonus. The verifier counts each locked token once and excludes it from reuse until the epoch ends. Splitting stake S across N accounts leaves their combined share unchanged; a larger share requires more capital, which the attacker cannot spend while locked. This assumes identical eligibility rules and no minimum payout that rewards splitting.
